channel.title: 1ClickDL — macOS updates
channel.description: Official 1ClickDL updates for macOS on Apple Silicon.

item.title: 1ClickDL 1.15.0
item.description: Quick access from Safari or any browser: menu-bar link entry, queue count, destination selection and batch start/pause. Optional configurable Command-Shift-V adds the copied link to the queue. No clipboard polling. Enable in Settings > Quick access. Existing settings, accounts, local YouTube session and downloads are preserved. Windows remains 1.14.0. Initial installer is not Apple notarized; guide: https://1clickdl.com/en/guide/.
